newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Naked soldiers pay the price for bar room frolic.
newsitem.headline: Naked soldiers pay the price for bar room frolic.

text.p: Three naked British soldiers enjoying a drink in a crowded bar in a Cyprus holiday resort were arrested by police on Wednesday.
The three were charged with indecency and each fined 150 pounds ($295) at a civilian court, a British army spokesman said.
"While regrettable, last night's incident can only be put down to high jinks," spokesman Mervyn Wynne-Jones said.
The three Royal Marines - Glynn Mike McNary, 19, Matthew Ronald Hughes, 22, and Paul Anthony Bray, 22 - were in Cyprus on a training mission.
